text: CHANGE when no `retryTime` is set in `replicateRxCollection()`, a failed pull or push handler call is no longer retried every 5 seconds. The first retry waits 200 milliseconds and the wait grows by the factor 1.3 on each consecutive failed call up to 5 seconds. It starts at 200 milliseconds again after a successful call. A `retryTime` that is set explicitly stays constant
